Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Meenakshi - 35 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ishaan dances to the music.]

Ishaan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ishaan claps his hands.]

Ishaan: "Oh wow!"

[Ishaan scratches his head.]

Ishaan: "How beautiful!"

[Ishaan whispers something to Mother.]

Ishaan: "This is amazing!"

[Ishaan shouts angrily.]

Meenakshi: "One more time!"

[Ishaan gives Mother a flower.]

Meenakshi: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

[Ishaan stands in the bedroom. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Ishaan: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan yawns loudly.]

Ishaan (laughing): "Yes, all right."

[Ishaan stretches his arms above his head.]

Ishaan (laughing): "I really enjoyed today."
